cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Handoff Already Happened
cards.instruction: Get them to accept responsibility by returning to earlier offers until the task seems to have been assigned all along.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You volunteered to finish the fete's last detail—the banner. I taught you not to put a promise on a sign unless you could deliver it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And legible from the gate this time. It says 'raffle at three'. Now find the prizes and someone to sell tickets.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I offered to paint words, not run a raffle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You offered to finish that last detail. Read your own three o'clock promise, the way I made you check every poster. Put your name beside it; I'll tell the others you're handling it.
